title: XML retrieval of TACACS server state must not crash non-sysmgr

source_facts.claim: The report says non-sysmgr crashes when `show tacacs-server` is requested through an XML client; it records a non-sysmgr core.
The Unit-test transcript sends a NETCONF get with a tacacs_dynamic_tree `show/tacacs-server` subtree and records replies for zero, one and two configured servers.
The report records a fix verification in release 7.0(3)I7(8.63); the test transcript itself displays an 7.0(3)I7(8.8) build / I7(9) version output.

uncertainties: XML namespace is release-specific; use the target release schema.

The 0/1/2 server states are in the historical unit transcript; the central coverage requirement is the XML TACACS-state query plus a crash/stability assertion, not necessarily all three states unless required for the target fix.
